roles.anyone: Anyone with a funded wallet. Pays only the transaction fee (and its own token account's rent when it buys for the first time); chooses no price.
roles.trader: Anyone, acting on their OWN wallet only: spends their own SOL or sells their own tokens, at the curve formula's price, within the slippage bound they set.
roles.pair_creator: The creator recorded in BOTH mints' burn_receipts TokenConfigs (initialize_token is mint-signed, so this is the launcher). Holds no power after init_pair; receives the rent of the accounts close_pair closes.

instructions.name: burn_lp
instructions.can: lp-lock blind review L-2 — the fallback if lock_lp cannot run (Raydium's upgradeable lock program refused or changed): once per side, only 30 days (LP_LOCK_FALLBACK_SECS) after the graduation decision and only while the side's LP is still unlocked, burn ALL of the vault's LP for that side, record it in lp_locked (register_pair_pool counts burned + locked LP) and close the emptied LP account (rent to the side's burn pool). The side's LP fees are forgone. The only instruction that destroys LP.
instructions.cannot: Run before the 30 days, after lock_lp, twice, or before the pool exists; burn less than all of the LP; move the LP or any SOL anywhere; take lamports from the vault (re-checked, hard error).
instructions.sunset: Once per side (and never once lock_lp ran).
instructions.funds: Vault LP → burned; emptied LP account's rent → the side's burn pool.

instructions.name: buy
instructions.can: While Open and before the deadline: pay F(sold + t) − F(sold) plus the 100 bps fee for t tokens of one side (the largest t the budget affords, capped at the curve supply), all into the SOL vault — the fee is accounted there: 75 bps escrowed for that side's burn pool (paid when its pool exists, returned to its holders on a void), 25 bps accrued for the developer wallet (claim_developer_fee). The trade that leaves the pair ready (target, minimum share, both pools affordable at the current AmmConfig) commits it.
instructions.cannot: Buy after the deadline, once committed, or after a void; pay any other account; move anyone else's funds; change the price formula; get tokens for 0 lamports.
instructions.funds: Buyer → SOL vault (curve cost + fee); token vault → buyer (tokens).

instructions.name: claim_developer_fee
instructions.can: Pay the accrued 25 bps developer share to the developer wallet recorded at init (from the pinned Burnticker platform).
instructions.cannot: Pay any other account; pay more than the accrual; run while the wallet cannot receive (executable, or below rent) — and its failure affects nothing else.
instructions.funds: SOL vault → developer wallet (the accrual only).

instructions.name: close_pair
instructions.can: Voided pairs only, once no token of either coin circulates outside the vault (burned tokens count as gone): burn the returned supplies, pay the developer accrual (to the burn pools instead if the developer wallet cannot receive it), send the SOL vault's lamports above its rent minimum to the two burn pools, close the token vaults and the Pair with their rent to the recorded creator (to burn pool A if that address is executable).
instructions.cannot: Close a committed or graduated pair (its Pair account is what burn_receipts' register_pair_pool reads); close while tokens circulate; send residue anywhere but the burn pools or rent anywhere but the creator (or burn pool A).
instructions.funds: Developer accrual → developer wallet (or the burn pools); SOL vault residue → burn pools; account rent → the creator.

instructions.name: graduate
instructions.can: Once per side. The first call (combined raise ≥ target, each side ≥ its minimum share, before the deadline) commits the pair and closes both curves. Each call wraps that side's raise less CPMM's fee and rents, creates the side's Raydium CPMM pool at the pair_curve PDA ["pool", pair, [side]] with the vault as creator and the pinned AmmConfig, at the curve's last price, burns every token the pool did not need, keeps the pool's LP in the vault's LP account for lock_lp, and sends the side's escrowed burn share, rent refunds and dust to the side's burn pool.
instructions.cannot: Graduate before the condition holds or after the deadline (first call); pick the amounts, the price, the pool address or the AmmConfig; send the LP anywhere (it stays in the vault until lock_lp); send SOL anywhere but the pool, CPMM's fee/rents and the burn pool; leave the vault re-assigned or a vault token account delegated or close-authorised (re-checked after the CPI, hard errors).
instructions.funds: SOL vault → its WSOL account → the side's CPMM pool (and CPMM's create-pool fee + rents); token vault → the pool; LP → the vault's LP account (until lock_lp); leftover tokens → burned; residue → the side's burn pool.

instructions.name: init_pair
instructions.can: Create the ONE Pair of two fresh mints (zero supply, 6 decimals, no freeze authority, mint authority = the pair's SOL vault PDA) whose TokenConfigs are burn_receipts policy 2 with the same pinned LaunchLab platform and cpConfigId: fix the curve parameters, the combined target, the minimum side share and the deadline (all validated, never writable again); mint 1,000,000,000 of each coin into its token vault and revoke the mint authority; read the developer wallet from the pinned platform.
instructions.cannot: Run twice for a pair or ever again on the same mints (they have no mint authority afterwards); be run by anyone but the recorded creator; choose the fee, its recipients, the AmmConfig or the burn pools; keep any token or any authority.
instructions.funds: Payer → the Pair, the two token vaults (rent) and the SOL vault's rent minimum.

instructions.name: lock_lp
instructions.can: LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35: once per side, after graduate — move ALL of the side's pool LP from the vault into Raydium's CPMM lock program (lock_cp_liquidity; permanent, never withdrawable), its Fee Key NFT (mint = the pair_curve PDA ["fee_nft", pair, [side]]) minted to burn_receipts' FEE_KEYS PDA, so burn_receipts' claim_lock_fees splits the pool's LP fees 80 % burn pool / 20 % operator and burns the coin side; close the emptied LP account (rent to the side's burn pool). The cranker pays the lock's rents.
instructions.cannot: Lock less than all of the LP, lock twice, lock before the pool exists; send the Fee Key anywhere but FEE_KEYS; let the lock program take lamports from the vault, re-assign it, or leave LP in the vault (all re-checked after the CPI, hard errors).
instructions.funds: Vault LP → Raydium's lock (forever); Fee Key → FEE_KEYS; emptied LP account's rent → the side's burn pool; cranker → the lock's rents.

instructions.name: sell
instructions.can: While Open and before the deadline: return t tokens of one side for F(sold) − F(sold − t) less the 100 bps fee (accounted in the vault like a buy's). After a void, or on a refunded side: a pro-rata redemption at the snapshot (curve SOL + the escrowed burn share), no fee, the same rate whatever the order of exits.
instructions.cannot: Sell on the curve at/after the deadline (the pair can only void then); sell once graduation is committed (except a refunding side); sell more than is outstanding; receive more than the formula or the pro-rata share; touch the other side's SOL.
instructions.funds: Seller → token vault (tokens); SOL vault → seller (proceeds less fee, or the redemption).

instructions.name: void_pair
instructions.can: At or after the deadline, if never committed: mark the pair Voided and snapshot each side's redemption pool (curve SOL + escrowed burn share). On a committed pair: put each missing side into redemption once 3 days have passed and Raydium blocks it (creation disabled, or the fee leaves no liquidity), or once 30 days have passed whatever the reason; both sides refunded with no pool → Voided.
instructions.cannot: Void before the deadline, or twice; refund a side whose pool exists; refund a missing side within 30 days of the commit unless Raydium blocks it; move any funds.
instructions.timelock: The pair's deadline; 3 days after the commit for a blocked side; 30 days after the commit for any missing side.

non_powers: No admin, authority, owner or operator field exists in the program; no instruction takes a privileged signer after init_pair.
No instruction updates a pair's parameters (virtual reserves, curve supply, target, minimum share, deadline, fee, fee recipients, AmmConfig) after init_pair.

No withdraw, sweep or transfer-out instruction exists for the SOL vault or the token vaults. SOL leaves the vault only as a seller's formula proceeds, the fee legs (fixed recipients, formula amounts), the CPMM deposit at graduation (formula amounts; the LP is then locked forever by lock_lp, LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35 — or, only if lock_lp cannot run for 30 days, burned by burn_lp) and residue to the burn pools.
No pause or freeze exists. Buys end at the deadline; nothing can stop sells on an open or voided pair.
No mint authority survives init_pair and no freeze authority ever exists; the program never mints after init.
The pair program holds the 75 bps burn share only in escrow: it reaches the side's burn_receipts fee PDA when the pool is created, or goes back to that side's holders on a void.

No trade credits any account but the SOL vault and the trader: the developer's 25 bps accrue in the vault (claim_developer_fee) and the 75 bps burn share is escrowed there until the side's pool exists — so neither the developer wallet nor a burn pool can block a trade or an exit.
The developer wallet is the claim wallet of the ONE LaunchLab platform compiled into the build (BURNTICKER_PLATFORM); a creator cannot route the 25 bps elsewhere.
A committed or graduated pair is never closed, so burn_receipts can always register its pools.

upgrade_authority.power: Program upgrade authority (BPF Upgradeable Loader) — outside the IDL, the one power above all of this.
upgrade_authority.holder_at_launch: The same Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig vault and time lock as burn_receipts (docs/burnticker/runbook.md "Pair program gates").
upgrade_authority.sunset: Set to none (`solana program set-upgrade-authority <PROGRAM_ID> --final`, through the multisig) on the same finalisation plan as burn_receipts.

external_powers.can: Change the pinned AmmConfig's create-pool fee or disable pool creation on it; upgrade the CPMM program.
external_powers.effect: Before the first graduate: graduation can fail (InsufficientPoolSol / CPMM refusal) and the pair voids at its deadline — every holder can sell back. Between the two sides: the second side waits; a side Raydium blocks for 3 days after the commit, or any side still missing 30 days after it, is refunded pro rata to its holders. A hostile CPMM upgrade cannot re-assign the vault or its token accounts or take more than the pool costs (post-CPI checks; tests/lifecycle.rs with mocks/evil_cpmm_init).

external_powers.holder: the key that created the pinned LaunchLab platform
external_powers.can: Change platformClaimFeeWallet and cpConfigId on the platform.
external_powers.effect: None on an existing pair: init_pair copies the developer wallet and the cpConfigId (from the TokenConfigs' pins) into the Pair.
